name: MJ2955G
description: onsemi MJ2955G, a PNP power transistor in TO-204AA (B1, E2, case C): VCEO 60 V, 15 A, 115 W at 25 C case; hFE 20 to 70 at 4 A and at least 5 at 10 A, VCE(sat) 1.1 V maximum at 4 A, VBE(on) 1.5 V maximum at 4 A. The model's gain is 37, the middle of the 4 A limits.

omissions: the gain's fall at high current (5 minimum at 10 A): it stays 37
the Early effect: the collector current does not rise with VCE
capacitances and fT, so no switching times
temperature: VBE's -2 mV/C and the gain's rise
second breakdown, the safe operating area and damage past the ratings
device-to-device spread within the gain limits
